quest.title: Nine Pillars of Peace
quest.description: Nine stone pillars stand stoic near Cuijue Slope. They seem to hide a certain secret...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Mora x180000, Adeptus' Temptation x5, Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Mora x200000

dialogues.speaker: Inscription
dialogues.text: "All the turmoils in the world have their root in human vice..."

dialogues.speaker: Inscription
dialogues.text: "Nine pillars we raise here to suppress conflict, that we may never again raise armies against each other..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We have a deal.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Well, here's the money, then. I'll take the ring in exchange.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: If you ever pick up any other antiques that you'd like to sell, feel free to come to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you help us look at this antique?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: An antique? Well, you've come to the right person. I'd say that I'm the fairest at valuating such things in all of Liyue. Let's see it.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Hmm, both the gemstone and the band are of fine quality, and it is very ancient... Yet it is very well-preserved — highly unusual.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Still, I can't say I've ever heard the phrase "Disaster runs rampant throughout the world , and all who live do so in agony."

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Never mind that. Where did you find this ring?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In a ruin near Cuijue Slope.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: You... You're a fair hand at this, aren't you? Not many dare to go there to hunt for treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Were those ruins surrounded by nine pillars, with a stone tablet in the center, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Don't look so surprised. I've heard many people who come to do business with me mention that place. They always say that such a large formation must have some sort of treasure within.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: They even say that those pillars and that ruin were built by Liyue's forebears in order to quell conflict...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: But I suppose that's just a legend. After all, if nine stone pillars could quell strife, this world would have been at peace long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: But regardless of whether this legend is true or not, this ring was found in that ruin, and has to be related to that legend.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: It's got a name, a history to go with it, and it's of good quality, too. It'll fetch a fine price.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: ...Relax, I'm not going to ask how you got in there. I just do business. Other matters are none of my concern.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: All in all, I'd say this ring's worth <color=#00E1FFFF>200,000 Mora</color>. What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Regarding that ring...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Oh, you've considered the matter? Will you sell or not, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Regarding that ring...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Have you considered it? Well then, are you willing to sell it to me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me give it a little thought...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: You... Well, alright. Give it some thought. Perhaps my offer isn't the best you've heard.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: But when it comes to business, I'll do right by you should you sell it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Think about it. This ring won't stop changing hands with me. If you sell it to me now, don't you think I'll let you in on any further transactions that take place down the line?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Moreover, I'm willing to add some things on, to boot...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Think on it carefully, and come back to me anytime should you decide to sell!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sold.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Very decisive. Here's the money. It's yours.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Ah, this ring is a true treasure...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: There must be other such gems within those ruins...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you help us look at this antique?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Antiques and curios? I'm not too familiar with them, but I'll have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: This ring... Huh, it's set with a jade gem, and one of good quality, too. Just the gem alone would be worth a sum.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: There's an inscription on it, too... "Disaster runs rampant throughout the world , and all who live do so in agony..." Where did you find this ring?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In a ruin near Cuijue Slope.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Cuijue Slope, huh... Tsk tsk, what a shame. Jueyun Karst is so nearby, too...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: If this ring came from a ruin in Jueyun Karst, it would surely fetch a great price.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, without any storied origin, this one's price falls a great deal. But it's of good quality. I'm sure someone would want it nonetheless.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: How about this? I'll offer you <color=#00E1FFFF>180,000 Mora</color> for this ring, with a few add-ons to boot. Would you sell it to me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This ruin gives Paimon the creeps. But this should be the end of it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And we got some treasure for our efforts, too — we even got ourselves that ring!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go find someone who has an <color=#00E1FFFF>eye for antiques</color> and see how much it'll sell for.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What add-ons?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: What, you ask... Well, it'll be good, that's for sure. I won't do wrong by you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need to give it some thought.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: My prices are likely to be the fairest. If you have any problem with it, you can go and check with other people.

talks.objective: Fetch a good price for the Dull Ring
Fetch a good price for the Dull Ring

dialogues.speaker: Inscription
dialogues.text: "Greed, nostalgia, vision, jealousy, anger, lust, self-aggrandizement, competition, turmoil..."

dialogues.speaker: Inscription
dialogues.text: "These nine mortal desires may heal the world, or do it great hurt. Their fire will never diminish, and it will never fade...Thus, we lay down nine pillars to bring peace, to end here the conflicts that plague this world."

dialogues.speaker: Inscription
dialogues.text: "If one who comes after will break those pillars and enter, war shall once again consume the world."

dialogues.speaker: Inscription
dialogues.text: "O you who read this tablet, claim the treasure that lies within, and bring peace to Liyue."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sold.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Very decisive. Here's the money. It's yours.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Ah, this ring is quite something.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: There must be other such gems within those ruins...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What add-ons?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: What, you ask... Well, it'll be good, that's for sure. I won't do wrong by you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me think again...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Are you comparing prices, or what...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Fine. Consider the matter carefully. I'll be here to seal the deal if you're willing to sell.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sold.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Well, here's the money, then. I'll take the ring in exchange.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: If you ever pick up any other antiques that you'd like to sell, feel free to come to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need to give it some more thought.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: How conscientious of you. Well, go ahead then. Compare the prices as much as you wish.
